    if n == 1:
        return 0
    if (n & 1) == 0:
        return (n & 1) - 1
    return 2 if n == 5 else 1

def main():
    x = int(input())
    a = []
    for _ in range(x):
        a.append(int(input()))
    a.sort()
    print(a[get_index(x)])
